mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 240 (index 1982-1984=100) indicates high inflation, triggering aggressive monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and economic activity, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its historical median.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic output.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates monetary tightening coinciding with economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust consumer spending (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars) indicates strong demand for goods and services, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 450000.
